purpose: R2R-only fixed Core curation. RxR assets and runtime behavior remain frozen.

reviewer.dynamic_selection: existing paired 6-8 examples for selected non-Core Generator Dynamic IDs plus 2-4 Diagnostics

runtime.note: Promoted Reviewer source cases are excluded by their own template_id. Reviewer Core pair_id is semantic provenance only and does not remove unrelated paired Dynamic examples. The runtime selects paired Dynamic examples only for selected non-Core Generator Dynamic IDs; remaining unselected Core-related paired records may stay in the pool but are not eligible for a current task unless their Generator source is selected.

reviewer_pair_semantics: pair_id is provenance only; Reviewer Core order R01-R10 is independent of Generator Core order. Runtime Core loading never selects or gates Reviewer cases by Generator Core selection.

drift_assessment.comparison_basis: Archived LLM-decompose-v5 host/template_selector.py and host/compile.py versus v6.1-prompt-only R2R profile behavior; this is a code-path comparison, not an empirical attribution of SR/SPL/nDTW changes.

v5_r2r_prompt_composition.selection: Three stable Core examples plus five source-tag-matched examples; source-identical examples are excluded.

v6_r2r_prompt_composition.selection: All examples were task-selected; there was no unconditional R2R semantic calibration set.

observed_structural_drift: The v5 R2R prompt always had a small stable Core alongside adaptive examples; v6 removed the R2R fixed Core entirely.
The v6 R2R example mix therefore varied with source features on every task, changing which semantic decision boundaries were visible to the model.
The v5 selector used a three-Core-plus-five-adaptive composition and tag-overlap ranking; v6 used a different feature/relation/coverage ranking and 6-8 adaptive examples.
R2R Reviewer teaching was similarly task-selected, with paired examples and diagnostics, but no fixed Reviewer calibration set.
drift_assessment.v6_2_scope: Restore a fixed, curated ten-example R2R Core per role while retaining v6.1 shared prompts, schemas, runtime workflow, and the existing v6 dynamic ranking algorithm/count. Promoted source copies are excluded from Dynamic to avoid duplicate injection.
drift_assessment.causal_status: Plausible structural drift and a testable recovery hypothesis, not a proven cause of the observed navigation metric drop. Only paired model/data evaluation can establish causal impact.
